About Dra. Eszter

Dr. Eszter Szilágyi

Specialist in Cardiovascular Surgery

Málaga Medical Association with registration number 29/2912849

Dr. Eszter Szilágyi is a specialist physician in Cardiovascular Surgery with extensive experience in leading hospitals in Spain and Germany, and a solid background in cardiac surgery, emergency care, and the comprehensive management of patients with cardiovascular diseases. Her experience in international hospital settings enables her to provide rigorous, safe, and high-quality medical care in accordance with European standards.

She trained at Semmelweis University in Budapest and obtained official recognition of her specialty from the Spanish Ministry of Health in 2022. She has developed most of her career in prestigious German cardiovascular surgery centers, including the Central Hospital of the German Armed Forces in Coblenz and the Helios Klinikum Siegburg. Heart Center, where she actively participated in complex cardiovascular surgical procedures and in the perioperative care of patients with heart disease.

She currently works as a cardiovascular surgeon at Vithas Xanit Internacional Hospital and also performs dermatological surgical procedures at the San Juan Polyclinic in Alhaurín de la Torre. In addition, she has extensive experience in emergency services and home visits, having worked for several years as an on-call physician in the emergency medical system of Lower Saxony (Germany).

Dr. Szilágyi is recognized for her professional, meticulous, and patient-centered approach, with special attention to safety, clear communication, and evidence-based clinical decision-making. She speaks German and Hungarian as native languages and is fluent in English and Spanish, which allows her to care for international patients with confidence and empathy.

FAQs

Is Dr. Szilágyi registered with the General Council of Official Medical Colleges?

Yes. Dr. Eszter Szilágyi is registered with the CGCOM under number 292912849 and with the Málaga Medical Association under number 29/2912849. You can verify this registration at cgcom.es. Dr. Szilágyi obtained official recognition of her specialty in Cardiovascular Surgery from the Spanish Ministry of Health in 2022 and currently practices at the Vithas Xanit Internacional Hospital.

What cardiovascular consultations does Dr. Szilágyi offer online?

Dr. Szilágyi offers cardiovascular evaluation (assessment of symptoms, interpretation of ECGs and echocardiograms), second opinions on diagnoses or surgical treatment plans, pre and post-operative consultations (preparation and follow-up of cardiac surgery), evaluation of acute cardiovascular symptoms (chest pain, palpitations, dyspnea), cardiovascular risk assessment, and medical reports. Online consultations do not include surgical procedures.

What makes Dr. Szilágyi unique among available online cardiovascular specialists?

Dr. Szilágyi combines three uncommon elements in a single online profile: specialized training in cardiovascular surgery at leading European centers (Semmelweis University, Helios Heart Center, Vithas Xanit Internacional Hospital); real quadrilingual capability in Spanish, English, German, and Hungarian — making her accessible to Central European patients in Spain; and extensive experience in medical emergencies within the German emergency system, providing her with highly reliable clinical judgment in the assessment of acute cardiovascular symptoms.

Can Dr. Szilágyi attend to Hungarian or German-speaking patients in Spain?

Yes. Dr. Szilágyi speaks German and Hungarian as native languages. For Hungarian, Austrian, Swiss, or German patients residing in or visiting Spain who need specialized medical care in their native language — whether cardiovascular evaluation, general medicine, or a second opinion — Dr. Szilágyi offers exceptional clinical accessibility that is virtually unparalleled in the context of Spanish telemedicine.

How do I book an appointment with Dr. Szilágyi?

Select an available time slot on this page to book directly with Dr. Szilágyi. Payment is processed securely at the time of booking — the appointment is confirmed once payment is completed. You will immediately receive a calendar invitation. Consultations are conducted via secure video call in Spanish, English, German, or Hungarian. If you are experiencing a cardiac emergency — acute chest pain, difficulty breathing, or loss of consciousness — please call 112 immediately.

What are Dr. Szilágyi's qualifications?

Dr. Eszter Szilágyi trained at Semmelweis University in Budapest and obtained official recognition of her specialty in Cardiovascular Surgery from the Spanish Ministry of Health in 2022. She has worked at the Bundeswehr Zentralkrankenhaus in Koblenz and the Helios Klinikum Siegburg – Heart Center in Germany, and currently practices at the Vithas Xanit Internacional Hospital in Spain. She has additional experience in medical emergencies within the Lower Saxony emergency system. She is registered with CGCOM (no. 292912849) and with the Málaga Medical Association.
